title: SECTION B: SUMMARY
instructions: Read the passage below (Text B) and then answer the question that follows. Your summary must be written in your own words, in full sentences, and must not exceed 70 words. Indicate the number of words you have used at the end of your summary.

questions.question: Using your own words, summarise SEVEN key benefits of solar energy for rural communities as mentioned in Text B. Write your summary in a paragraph of no more than 70 words. Ensure that you include SEVEN distinct points and that your summary is coherent and in your own words.
memo: Content: 7 marks – one mark for each of the following points (must be in own words, but may be paraphrased):
1. Solar energy is renewable and does not pollute the environment (or helps fight climate change).
2. It lowers electricity costs because households/businesses generate their own power.
3. It reduces reliance on the unreliable national grid (especially in rural areas).
4. It creates local jobs in installation and maintenance of panels.
5. It boosts the local economy and reduces unemployment.
6. It improves education by allowing schools to use lights/computers after dark.
7. It improves healthcare by keeping vaccines cold and running medical equipment during outages.
- Own words (paraphrasing, not copying from the text): 1 mark
- Full sentences and coherence (logical flow, paragraph format): 1 mark
Note: If a candidate includes more than seven points, only the first seven are marked. If the summary exceeds 70 words, the language mark for word limit is lost.
